SELECT requested.device_id,s.id source_id,CAST(s.projectId AS CHAR) project_key, CASE WHEN s.transferFlag='-1' AND s.chProjectId IS NULL AND s.chContractNo IS NULL AND s.transferProjectId IS NULL AND s.transferContractNo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END clear_transfer FROM (
SELECT #{device.id} device_id,#{device.sn} sn SELECT 0 device_id,'' sn WHERE 1=0 ) requested JOIN pm_project_shipment s ON s.id=(SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM pm_project_shipment latest WHERE latest.barcode=requested.sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)
